cards.title: What is RegEx?
cards.body_tr: Regular expression (RegEx), metinde **desen** aramaya yarayan özel bir yazım biçimidir. Python'da `re` modülüyle kullanılır. Beş ana fonksiyon: `match`, `search`, `findall`, `split`, `sub`.
cards.body: A regular expression (RegEx) is a special notation for finding **patterns** in text. In Python you use the `re` module. Five main functions: `match`, `search`, `findall`, `split`, `sub`.
cards.code:
import re

print(re.match.__name__, re.search.__name__, re.findall.__name__)

cards.title: re.match: look at the start
cards.body_tr: `match` yalnız metnin **başında** arar. Bulursa match nesnesi, bulamazsa `None` döner. `.span()` başlangıç ve bitişi verir; `re.I` büyük/küçük harfi yok sayar.
cards.body: `match` only looks at the **start** of the text. It returns a match object or `None`. `.span()` gives start and end; `re.I` ignores case.
cards.code:
import re

txt = 'I love to teach python and javaScript'
match = re.match('I love to teach', txt, re.I)
print(match)
start, end = match.span()
print(start, end, txt[start:end])
cards.expected_output:
<re.Match object; span=(0, 15), match='I love to teach'>
0 15 I love to teach

cards.code:
import re

print(re.match('python', 'I love python'))
cards.why_tr: `match` başta arar; metin 'I love' ile başlıyor.
cards.why: `match` checks the start; the text starts with 'I love'.

cards.title: re.search: look anywhere
cards.body_tr: `search` metnin her yerinde arar ve **ilk** eşleşmeyi döndürür; yoksa `None`.
cards.body: `search` looks anywhere in the text and returns the **first** match, or `None`.
cards.code:
import re
txt = 'Python is the most beautiful language that a human being has ever created.\nI recommend python for a first programming language'
match = re.search('first', txt, re.I)
print(match.span())
start, end = match.span()
print(txt[start:end])

cards.statement_tr: `re.match` ve `re.search` her zaman aynı sonucu verir.
cards.statement: `re.match` and `re.search` always give the same result.
cards.why_tr: `match` yalnız başı kontrol eder, `search` her yeri.

cards.title: re.findall: find all
cards.body_tr: `findall` tüm eşleşmeleri liste olarak döndürür. `re.I` ile `Python` ve `python` ikisini de yakalar.
cards.body: `findall` returns all matches as a list. With `re.I` it catches both `Python` and `python`.
cards.code:
import re
txt = 'Python is the most beautiful language that a human being has ever created.\nI recommend python for a first programming language'
print(re.findall('language', txt, re.I))
print(re.findall('python', txt, re.I))

cards.title: A pattern instead of a flag
cards.body_tr: `re.I` yerine deseni yazarak da aynı sonucu alırsın: `Python|python` ya da `[Pp]ython`. `|` 'veya', `[...]` 'bu karakterlerden biri' demektir.
cards.body: Instead of `re.I` you can write the pattern: `Python|python` or `[Pp]ython`. `|` means 'or'; `[...]` means 'one of these characters'.
cards.code:
import re
txt = 'Python is the most beautiful language that a human being has ever created.\nI recommend python for a first programming language'
print(re.findall('Python|python', txt))
print(re.findall('[Pp]ython', txt))

import re

print(re.___('a', 'banana'))

cards.title: re.sub: replace
cards.body_tr: `re.sub(desen, yerine, metin)` eşleşenleri değiştirir. Dikkat: dördüncü parametre `count`tur, bayrak değil; `re.I`yi `flags=re.I` diye vermelisin (derste hata vardı).
cards.body: `re.sub(pattern, replacement, text)` replaces matches. Careful: the fourth positional parameter is `count`, not flags; pass `flags=re.I` (the lesson got this wrong).
cards.code:
import re
txt = 'Python is the most beautiful language that a human being has ever created.\nI recommend python for a first programming language'
print(re.sub('python', 'JavaScript', txt, flags=re.I))
cards.expected_output:
JavaScript is the most beautiful language that a human being has ever created.
I recommend JavaScript for a first programming language

cards.code:
import re

print(re.sub('%', '', 'P%y%t%h%on'))
cards.why: Replacing with an empty string removes the `%` signs.

cards.title: re.split: split
cards.body_tr: `re.split(desen, metin)` metni eşleşme noktalarından bölüp liste döndürür. `\n` satır sonudur.
cards.body: `re.split(pattern, text)` splits at the matches and returns a list. `\n` is the end-of-line character.
cards.code:
import re

txt = 'I am teacher.\nI love teaching.\nDo you?'
print(re.split('\n', txt))

cards.title_tr: Ham yazı r'' ve meta karakterler
cards.title: Raw strings r'' and meta characters
cards.body_tr: Desenleri `r'...'` (ham yazı) ile yaz; ters eğik çizgi olduğu gibi kalır. Özel karakterler: `[]` küme, `\d` rakam, `.` herhangi karakter, `^` başlangıç, `$` son, `*` sıfır+, `+` bir+, `?` sıfır ya da bir, `{n}` tam n, `|` veya.
cards.body: Write patterns as `r'...'` (raw string) so backslashes stay as they are. Special characters: `[]` set, `\d` digit, `.` any character, `^` start, `$` end, `*` zero+, `+` one+, `?` zero or one, `{n}` exactly n, `|` or.
cards.code:
import re

txt = 'Apple and banana are fruits. An old cliche says an apple a day'
print(re.findall(r'apple', txt))
print(re.findall(r'apple', txt, re.I))
print(re.findall(r'[Aa]pple', txt))

cards.statement_tr: `r'\d+'` gibi ham yazı (raw string), ters eğik çizgiyi özel işaret saymadan olduğu gibi bırakır.
cards.statement: A raw string like `r'\d+'` keeps the backslash as is instead of treating it as an escape.
cards.why: Using `r''` for patterns is the safe habit.

cards.title: Square brackets [ ]
cards.body_tr: `[Aa]` 'A ya da a' demektir. `|` ile birleştirip birden çok kelime arayabilirsin.
cards.body: `[Aa]` means 'A or a'. Join with `|` to search several words.
cards.code:
import re

txt = 'Apple and banana are fruits. An old cliche says an apple a day a doctor way has been replaced by a banana a day'
print(re.findall(r'[Aa]pple|[Bb]anana', txt))

cards.title: \d: digit
cards.body_tr: `\d` tek bir rakamı yakalar. Bu yüzden `2019` dört ayrı parça olur. İstediğimiz bu değil, bir sonraki kartta düzeltiyoruz.
cards.body: `\d` matches a single digit, so `2019` becomes four separate pieces. Not what we want; the next card fixes it.
cards.code:
import re

txt = 'made on December 6, 2019 and revised on July 8, 2021'
print(re.findall(r'\d', txt))

cards.title: + : one or more
cards.body_tr: `\d+` ardışık rakamları tek parça olarak alır.
cards.body: `\d+` takes consecutive digits as one piece.
cards.code:
import re

txt = 'made on December 6, 2019 and revised on July 8, 2021'
print(re.findall(r'\d+', txt))

import re

print(re.findall(r'\d+', 'a12b345c6'))
cards.why_tr: `+` ardışık rakam gruplarını tek parça yakalar.
cards.why: `+` captures each run of digits as one piece.

cards.title: Period (.)
cards.body_tr: `.` satır sonu dışında herhangi bir karakteri temsil eder. `[a].` 'a ve ardından bir karakter' demektir; `.+` ise sonuna kadar alır.
cards.body: `.` stands for any character except a newline. `[a].` means 'a followed by one character'; `.+` takes everything to the end.
cards.code:
import re

txt = 'Apple and banana are fruits'
print(re.findall(r'[a].', txt))
print(re.findall(r'[a].+', txt))

import re

print(re.findall(r'a.', 'banana'))
cards.why_tr: Son 'a'dan sonra karakter yok, o yüzden eşleşmez.
cards.why: The last 'a' has nothing after it, so it does not match.

cards.title: * : zero or more
cards.body_tr: `*` önceki öğenin hiç olmamasına da çok olmasına da izin verir. `.*` neredeyse her şeyi yakalar.
cards.body: `*` allows the previous item to be absent or repeated. `.*` grabs nearly anything.
cards.code:
import re

txt = 'Apple and banana are fruits'
print(re.findall(r'[a].*', txt))

cards.title: ? : optional
cards.body_tr: `?` önceki öğe en fazla bir kez gelsin, yani isteğe bağlı olsun demektir. `[Ee]-?mail` hem `email` hem `e-mail`'i yakalar.
cards.body: `?` makes the previous item optional (at most once). `[Ee]-?mail` matches both `email` and `e-mail`.
cards.code:
import re

txt = 'write it as e-mail, email, Email or E-mail.'
print(re.findall(r'[Ee]-?mail', txt))

import re

print(re.findall(r'colou___r', 'color colour'))
cards.why_tr: `u?` u'yu isteğe bağlı yapar: color ve colour.
cards.why: `u?` makes the u optional: color and colour.

cards.title: Curly braces { }
cards.body_tr: `{4}` tam 4 kez, `{1,4}` 1 ile 4 arası tekrar demektir.
cards.body: `{4}` means exactly 4 times, `{1,4}` between 1 and 4 times.
cards.code:
import re

txt = 'made on December 6, 2019 and revised on July 8, 2021'
print(re.findall(r'\d{4}', txt))
print(re.findall(r'\d{1,4}', txt))

cards.title: ^ : start and negation
cards.body_tr: Desenin başında `^` 'ile başlar' demektir. Köşeli parantezin içinde ise 'bunlar hariç' anlamına gelir: `[^A-Za-z ]+` harf ve boşluk olmayanları yakalar.
cards.body: At the start of a pattern `^` means 'starts with'. Inside brackets it means 'not these': `[^A-Za-z ]+` catches everything but letters and spaces.
cards.code:
import re

txt = 'This example was made on December 6, 2019'
print(re.findall(r'^This', txt))
print(re.findall(r'[^A-Za-z ]+', txt))

cards.title: Summary
points_tr: `[]` küme, `\d` rakam, `.` her karakter, `^` başlangıç / olumsuzlama.
points: `match` checks the start, `search` finds the first, `findall` finds all.
`[]` set, `\d` digit, `.` any character, `^` start / negation.
